Roasted slowly in generous ghee until deep golden and extra crisp, usually
served as a tall cone. Jain-friendly (no onion or garlic) but NOT vegan —

griddle and the curry pots are running.

biryanis serve 11:30 AM–10 PM IST (lunch and dinner).

- We deliver only to the pincodes listed at checkout (Chennai:
  600001, 600002, 600004, 600017 in the demo configuration). Addresses
  outside these areas cannot complete checkout.
- If a delivery fails because the address or phone number provided was
  unreachable, the order is not refundable.
- Contactless delivery: request it in the order notes.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Delivery › Where do you deliver?
evidence.content:
Delivery is limited to a configured list of Chennai pincodes (currently the
600001, 600002, 600004, and 600017 areas). If your address's pincode isn't
served, checkout will tell you before payment.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Delivery › How long does delivery take?
evidence.content:
Prep time is shown per dish (idli ~10 min; dosas 15–20 min; biryani 25–35
min) plus travel time. You can watch live status: PLACED → CONFIRMED →
COOKING → READY → OUT FOR DELIVERY → DELIVERED.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Delivery › Can I schedule an order for later?
evidence.content: Not yet — orders go straight to the kitchen when placed.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Ordering › What are your hours?
evidence.content:
Kitchen hours are set by the restaurant and shown on the site. Outside
hours, or when the kitchen is temporarily paused, checkout is disabled and
the assistant will say so rather than take an order it can't fulfil.

evidence.heading: Ordering, Cancellation & Refund Policies › Demo deployment notice
evidence.content:
This is a portfolio demonstration. Payments run exclusively in Razorpay
TEST mode: no real charges, no real deliveries, and synthetic order history
is used for analytics and forecasting demos.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Telegram & account › How is my data handled?
evidence.content:
We store your phone number, addresses, order history, and preferences
(diet, allergens, spice, language) to personalise service. Phone numbers
are redacted before any text reaches an AI model or a log line.

evidence.heading: Frequently Asked Questions › Ordering › How do I place an order?
evidence.content:
Three ways, all against the same menu and account:

1. **Website** — browse the menu, add to cart, and check out.
2. **Telegram** — chat with the DosaDash bot; link it to your account once
   and order by message (voice notes arrive in a later release).
3. **AI assistant** — ask in plain language ("2 masala dosas and a filter
   coffee"); the assistant builds an order draft you confirm before anything
   is placed. Nothing is ever ordered without your explicit confirmation.
